title: Exodus 14:1-4 — camp at Pi-hahiroth (16 Nisan); God will harden Pharaoh's heart
summary: Exodus 14:1-4 in English: the LORD tells Moses to have Israel turn back and camp before Pi-hahiroth between Migdol and the sea, saying He will harden Pharaoh's heart and be honored through Pharaoh and his army. Below, pi-hahiroth פי החירת is shown with the date 16 Nisan, colour-matched.

text.text: 1 Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
2 “Tell the sons of Israel to turn back and camp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea; you shall camp in front of Baal-zephon, opposite it, by the sea.
3 “For Pharaoh will say of the sons of Israel, ‘They are wandering aimlessly in the land; the wilderness has shut them in.’
4 “Thus I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and he will chase after them; and I will be honored through Pharaoh and all his army, and the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD.” And they did so.

words.gloss: Pi-hahiroth, camp by the sea before Baal-zephon

uncertain: Purpose of the multicoloured letters in Pi-hahiroth and LORD is not stated on the slide
